Official Tory Burch UK product-page Size Guide (Clothing, Cm): Fine Rib Turtleneck

audit: Old /en-gb/help/size-guide 404s (toryburch.co.uk redirects to toryburch.com/en-gb) and Client Services has no size guide; product-page 'Size Guide' Clothing chart, identical on two tops, Cm toggle (inches in _in). Prints XXS-XL with 'Tory Burch US' 0, 0-2, 4-6, 8-10, 12, 14 (XXS and XS both include US 0, as printed), UK/AU 2, 4-6, 8-10, 12-14, 16, 18 and Chest/Waist/Hips; the second 'Tory Burch US' row (23-24...) is a denim waist size, not stored. 'Chest' stored as chest. Old mapping was off: XS 'UK 6' 82/63/87 -> UK 4-6 82.5-85/65-67.5/90-92.75; M 'UK 10' 90/71/95 -> UK 12-14 92.75-96.5/75-78.5/100.5-104; XL 'UK 14' 100/81/105 -> UK 18 104.5/86.5/112. XXS added; EU removed (not printed). A separate XS/S, M/L table is not stored.
